फ: फ The twenty-second consonant of the Nāgari Alphabet, the aspirate of the preceding letter, and expressed by Ph.

फ m. (-फः) 	 1. Increasing, swelling, enlarging, expanding. 	 2. Perform-ance of a mystical rite, by which KUVERA'S attendants are pro-pitiated. 	 3. A high wind, a gale. 	 4. Wind expelled in yawning. 	 5. Fruitfulness, fertility. 	 6. An augmentor or increaser. 	 nf. (फं-फा) Unprofitable or idle speech. 	 n. (-फं) 	 1. Angry speech. 	 2. Bursting with some little noise, as air bubbles, boiling water, &c.; bubbling, boiling. 	 f. (-फा) Distress, anxiety.  E. फल् to bear fruit, or स्फाय् to swell, aff. ड; in the latter case, the initial is rejected.
फक्क: फक्क r. 1st cl. (फक्कति) 	 1. To creep, to move slowly or sluggishly. 	 2. To behave ill, to practise ill or improper conduct.
फक्किका: फक्किका f. (-का) 	 1. A position, an assertion or argument, to be proved or maintained. 	 2. Logical exposition or elucidation. 	 3. A sophism. 4. A trick. 	 5. Illusion. 	 6. Fraud.  E. फक्क् to move slowly, aff. ण्वुल् टाप् ।
फञ्जिका: फञ्जिका f. (-का) 	 1. A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.) 	 2. A species of Hedysarum, (H. alhagi.)  E. भञ्ज् to break, (disease,) aff. ण्वुल्, and the radical initial changed to फ ।
फञ्जिपुत्रिका: फञ्जिपुत्रिका f. (-का) A plant, (Talvinia cucullata.)  E. फञ्जि as above, and पुत्रिका infant. “उन्दुरकानि” ।
फट: फट mfn. subst. (-टः-टा-टं) The expanded hood or neck of the Cobra de capello. 	 mf. (-टः-टा) 	 1. A tooth. 	 2. A cheat.  E. स्फुट् to burst or expand, aff. अच् fem. aff. टाप्, deriv. irr.
फट्: फट् Ind. Exclamation of no meaning, forming part of a Mantra or in-cantation.  E. स्फुट् to burnt, aff. क्विप्, and the deriv. irr.
फडिङ्गा: फडिङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) A cricket, a locust.
फण: फण r. 1st cl. (फणति) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To produce easily or readily. 	 3. To be unoily, Causal form, (फाणयति) 	 1. To dilute. 	 2. To shine. (फणयति) To cause to go.
फण mfn. Subst. (-णः-णा-णं) The expanded hood or neck of the Cobra de capello, &c.  E. फण् to go, aff. अच् ।
फणकर: फणकर m. (-रः) A snake, especially the Cobra de capello, or COLUBER naja.  E. फल् the hood, and कर who makes; also फणाकर ।
फणधर: फणधर m. (-रः) A snake.  E. फण the hood, and धर who has; also फणाधर ।
फणभृत्: फणभृत् m. (-भृत्) A snake.  E. फण a hood, and भृत् who possesses.
फणमणि: फणमणि m. (-णिः) A jewel supposed to be in the head of a snake.  E. फण and मणि a gem.
फणवत्: फणवत् m. (-वान्) A snake.  E. फणा a hood, and मतुप् possessive aff.
फणाकर: फणाकर m. (-रः) A snake: see फणकर.
फणाधर: फणाधर m. (-रः) A snake: see फणधर ।
फणाभर: फणाभर m. (-रः) A snake.  E. फण the hood expanded, भृ to possess, aff. अच् ।
फणावत्: फणावत् m. (-वान्) A snake: see फणवत् ।
फणिकेशर: फणिकेशर m. (-रः) A plant, (Mesua ferrea.)  E. फणिन् a snake and केशर filaments.
फणिखेल: फणिखेल m. (-लः) A quail.  E. फणि a snake, and खेल who plays. “भारुइपाखि” ।
फणिज्झक: फणिज्झक m. (-कः) A plant, also Marua. 	 f. (-का) A plant, commonly Rāmadūti, apparently a sort of basil with small leaves.  E. फणि for फणी a snake, and उज्झ to abandon, aff. वुन् deriv. irr.
फणित: फणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Gone. 	 2. Diluted.  E. फण् to go, क्त aff.
फणितल्पग: फणितल्पग m. (-गः) VISHṆU whose bed in the serpent Sesha.  E. फणि a snake, तल्प a bed, and ग who goes.
फणिन्: फणिन् m. (-णी) A snake.  E. फण a hood, and इनि aff.
फणिप्रिय: फणिप्रिय m. (-यः) Air, wind.  E. फणि for फणी a snake, and प्रिय fond of.
फणिभाष्य: फणिभाष्य n. (-ष्यं) The commentary of Patanjali on Pānini's Sutras.
फणिभुज्: फणिभुज् m. (-भुक्) 	 1. An epithet of Garuda. 	 2. A Peacock.
फणिमुख: फणिमुख n. (-खं) An instrument for throwing earth.
फणीश्वर: फणीश्वर m. (-रः) 	 1. The great serpent ANANTA. 	 2. An epithet of Śesha. E. फणी a snake, and ईश्वर sovereign; also फणीन्द्र, &c.
फण्ड: फण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The belly.  E. फण् to go, Unādi aff. ड ।
फत्कारिन्: फत्कारिन् m. (-री) A bird.  E. फत् imitative sound, and कारिन् who makes.
फर: फर n. (-रं) A shield.  E. र substituted for ल; see फल ।
फर्फर: फर्फर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) One moving quickly.  E. स्फुर्-अच् ।
फर्फरीक: फर्फरीक m. (-कः) The Palm of the hand with the fingers extended. 	 n. (-कं) Young shoot or branch. 	 f. (-का) A shoe.
फरीक: फरीक m. (-कः) The palm of the hand with the fingers extended. 	 n. (-कं) Sweetness.  E. स्फुर् to expand, Unādi aff. ईकन् and the form irr.
फल्: फल् r. 1st cl. (फलति) 	 1. To produce or bear fruit. 	 2. To make fruitful, to fructify. 	 3. To go. (ञि, आ) ञिफला r. 1st cl. (फलति) To divide, to cleave or split.
फल: फल n. (-लं) 	 1. The fruit of any plant, fruit in general. 	 2. Fruit, (meta-phorically,) result, produce, consequence. 	 3. Prosperity, flourish-ing, thriving. 	 4. Gain, profit, acquisition. 	 5. Recompense, reward. 6. A shield. 	 7. The blade of a sword or knife, the head of an ar-row, &c. 	 8. A sort of fragrant berry and drug commonly Kākoli. 9. A nutmeg. 	 10. The three myrobalans collectively. 	 11. The men-strual discharge. 	 12. Gift, giving. 	 13. A ploughshare. 	 14. The quotient of a sum, (in arithmetic.) 	 15. The area of a circle, &c. 16. An equation. 	 17. (In astronomy,) The anomalistic equation of a planet. 	 f. (-ली) A medicinal plant, commonly Priangu. 	 m. (-लः) A plant, (Echites anti-dysenterica, Rox.:) see कुटज.  E. फल् to bear or produce fruit, aff. अच् ।
फलक: फलक mn. (-कः-कं) 	 1. A shield. 	 2. A bench. 	 3. A plank. 	 4. A layer. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A bone, the os frontis, or bone of the forehead. 	 2. A leaf or page for writing on. 	 3. A plant, (Mesua ferrea.) 	 n. (-कं) The buttocks.  E. कन् added to the preceding, or फल् to split or divide, aff. वुन् ।
फलकपाणि: फलकपाणि m. (-णिः) A soldier armed with a shield.  E. फलक and पाणि the hand.
फलकयन्त्र: फलकयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) An astronomical instrument invented by Bhāskarā-chārya.
फलकामना: फलकामना f. (-ना) Desire of any consequence.  E. फल, and कामना desiring.
फलकिन्: फलकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Having or being armed with a shield, &c. m. (-की) A sort of fish commonly Phalūi.  E. फलक as above and इनि aff.
फलकृष्ण: फलकृष्ण m. (-ष्णः) A small fruit, (Carissa carandas.)  E. फल fruit and कृष्ण black. “पानिआमलके” ।
फलकेशर: फलकेशर m. (-रः) The cocoanut-tree.  E. फल the fruit and केशर hair, covered with a fibrous coat-like hair.
फलकोषक: फलकोषक m. (-कः) 	 1. The cocoanut-tree. 	 2. The testicle.  E. फल fruit, कोष sheath, and कन् aff. of comparison.
फलखण्डन: फलखण्डन n. (-नं) Disappointing.  E. फल and खण्डन destroying.
फलग्रहि: फलग्रहि mfn. (-हिः-हिः-हि) Fruitful, bearing fruit in due season.  E. फल fruit, ग्रह् to take, aff. इन्, also फलेग्रहि ।
फलग्राहिन्: फलग्राहिन् m. (-ही) A tree.  E. फल fruit, ग्रह् to take, aff. णिनि ।
फलचमस: फलचमस m. (-सः) The bark of the Indian fig, ground and eaten with curds, by way of penance.
फलत्: फलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) Yielding fruit, profit, &c.  E. फल् to bear fruit, शतृ aff.
फलत्रय: फलत्रय n. (-यं) 	 1. Three sorts of fruit collectively, as the fruit of the vine, the Parush, and the Gmelina arborea. 	 2. The three myrobal-ans.  E. फल fruit and त्रय three.
फलत्रिक: फलत्रिक n. (-कं) The three myrobalans collectively.  E. फल fruit, and त्रिक three-fold. “शुण्ठीपिप्पली मरिचरूपायाम् च” ।
फलद: फलद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Yielding or bearing fruit, result, &c. 	 m. (-दः) A tree.  E. फल fruit, and द what gives; also फलदातृ, फलदायिन् &c.
फलन: फलन n. (-नं) Fructifying, bearing fruit, producing consequences. E. फल, and ल्युट् aff.
फलनिवृत्ति: फलनिवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Cessation of consequences.  E. फल and निवृत्ति stop.
फलनिर्वृत्ति: फलनिर्वृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Final consequence or result.  E. फल and निर्वृत्ति completion.
फलनिष्पत्ति: फलनिष्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 	 1. Bearing fruit. 	 2. Yielding profit or desired re-sults.  E. फल and निष्पत्ति putting forth.
फलपाक: फलपाक m. (-कः) 	 1. The ripening of fruit. 	 2. The fulness of conse-quences. 	 3. The Caronda.  E. फल fruit and पाक ripening.
फलपाकान्ता: फलपाकान्ता f. (-न्ता) An annual plant.  E. फल fruit, पाक ripening or ripe-ness, and अन्त end; dying after bearing fruit.
फलपातन: फलपातन n. (-नं) Knocking down or gathering fruit.  E. फल and पातन felling.
फलपुच्छ: फलपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) A sort of esculent root or bulb.  E. फल fruit and पुच्छ a tail.
फलपूर: फलपूर m. (-रः) Common citron, (Citrus medica.)  E. फल fruit and पूर् to fill, aff. क ।
फलपूरक: फलपूरक m. (-कः) Common citron.  E. कन् added to the last.
फलप्रद: फलप्रद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Yielding fruit, productive, yielding a reward, &c.  E. फल and प्रद what gives.
फलप्रदान: फलप्रदान n. (-नं) 	 1. A ceremony at weddings. 	 2. The giving of fruits.
फलप्रयुक्त: फलप्रयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Connected with or producing consequences, yielding fruit, &c.  E. फल and प्रयुक्त applied.
फलप्राप्ति: फलप्राप्ति f. (-प्तिः) Obtaining the desired result or fruit.  E. फल and प्राप्ति acquiring.
फलबन्धिन्: फलबन्धिन् Adj. Forming or developing fruits.
फलभाज्: फलभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Having or receiving fruit, consequence, &c.  E. फल and माज् who shares.
फलभूमि: फलभूमि f. (-मिः) Any region not included in the known continent, as heaven, hell, &c.  E. फल fruit, (of actions,) and भूमि land.
फलभोग: फलभोग m. (-गः) 	 1. Receipt or enjoyment of consequences. 	 2. Possess-ion of rent or profit, usufruct.  E. फल and भोग enjoyment.
फलभोगिन्: फलभोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Who receives the profits, consequences, &c.  E. फल and भोगिन् who enjoys.
फलमुद्गरिका: फलमुद्गरिका f. (-का) A sort of date.  E. फल fruit and मुद्गर a mallet, aff. कन् in the fem. form. “पिण्डीखेजुर” ।
फलयोग: फलयोग m. (-गः) 	 1. The attainment of an object. 	 2. Remuneration, wages.
फलवत्: फलवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 	 1. Bearing fruit. 	 2. Yielding results or con-sequences.  E. फल fruit and मतुप् poss. aff.
फलशाडव: फलशाडव m. (-वः) The promegranate.  E. फल fruit, शाड् to extol, aff. अव ।
फलशालिन्: फलशालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Bearing or yielding fruit.  E. फल and शलिन् having.
फलश्रेष्ठ: फलश्रेष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) The mango.  E. फल fruit and श्रेष्ठ best.
फलस: फलस m. (-सः) The jack or bread-fruit.  E. फल fruit, सह् to be able. aff. डः also read फलशः see पनस ।
फलसम्पद्: फलसम्पद् f. (पद् or -पत्) Prosperity, success.  E. फल and सम्पत् abundance.
फलसम्भव: फलसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced in or by fruit.  E. फल and सम्भव born also फलसम्भू ।
फलसाधन: फलसाधन n. (-नं) Means or instrument of success.  E. फल and साधन means.
फलसिद्धि: फलसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Realising an object, reaping the fruit of any act. E. फल and सिद्धि perfection.
फलहानि: फलहानि f. (-निः) Loss of fruit or profit.  E. फल and हानि abandonment.
फलहारी: फलहारी f. (-री) An epithet of Durgā.
फलाकाङ्क्षा: फलाकाङ्क्षा f. (-ङ्क्षा) Hope or expectation of favourable consequences. E. फल and आकाङ्क्षा desire.
फलादन: फलादन m. (-नः) A parrot.  E. फल fruit, अदन eating.
फलाध्यक्ष: फलाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) A tree, commonly Khirani, (Mimusops Kauki.)  E. फल fruit, अध्यक्ष superintendent.
फलान्त: फलान्त m. (-न्तः) A bamboo.  E. फल fruit or blossom, अन्त end.
फलानुमेय: फलानुमेय Adj. Inferable from consequences of results.
फलानुसरण: फलानुसरण n. (-णं) Rate or aggregate of profits.  E. फल and अनुसरण conformity.
फलापेक्षा: फलापेक्षा f. (-क्षा) Regard to or expectation of consequences.  E. फल and अपेक्षा expectation.
फलापेत: फलापेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Unproductive, unfertile.  E. फल and अपेत de-prived.
फलाभोग: फलाभोग m. (-गः) Non-enjoyment of profits, &c.  E. फल and अभोग non-use.
फलाशन: फलाशन m. (-नः) A parrot.  E. फल fruit and अशन food.
फलाशिन्: फलाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) Living on fruits.  E. फल and अशिन् who eats.
फलासक्त: फलासक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 	 1. Doing any thing for the sake of reward. 2. Fond of or seeking to pluck fruit.  E. फल and आसक्त attached to.
फलि: फलि m. (-लिः) A kind of fish. “फलुइ” ।
फलित: फलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Fruitful, bearing fruit. 	 2. Successful, yielding a result. 	 m. (-तः) A tree. 	 f. (-ता) A woman in her courses.  E. फल fruit and इतच् aff.
फलिन्: फलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 	 1. Bearing fruit, fruitful. 	 2. Productive of consequences. 	 m. (-नी) 	 1. A sort of fish, commonly Phalūi, (Mys-tus kapirat.) 	 2. A tree, (especially in fruit.) 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. A medicinal plant, commonly Priyangu. 	 2. A potherb, (Echites dichotoma.) 3. A flower, (Celosia cristata.)  E. फल fruit, and इनि aff.
फलूष: फलूष m. (-षः) A sort of creeper.  E. फल fruit, and ऊषन् Unādi aff.
फलेग्रहि: फलेग्रहि mfn. (-हिः-हिः-हि) Bearing fruit in season, fruitful.  E. फल fruit, ग्रह् to take, aff. इन्; ए substituted irregularly for the final of फल; also फलग्रहि and फलेग्राहिन् ।
फलेग्राहिन्: फलेग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Bearing fruit in due season. E. As above, णिनि aff.
फलेपुष्पा: फलेपुष्पा f. (-ष्पा) A kind of flower known as “द्रोणपुष्पी” ।
फलेरुहा: फलेरुहा f. (-हा) The trumpet-flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.)  E. फल fruit, in the seventh case, रुह् to grow, aff. क । “पाटलिवृक्षे” ।
फलोच्चय: फलोच्चय m. (-यः) 	 1. Collecting of fruits. 	 2. A collection of fruits.  E. फल and उच्चय abundance.
फलोत्तमा: फलोत्तमा f. (-मा) 	 1. A small sort of grape without stones. 	 2. The three myrobalans collectively. 	 3. The benefit arising from sacred study. E. फल fruit, उत्तम best.
फलोत्पति: फलोत्पति(त्ति) m. (-तिः or त्ति) The mango. 	 f. (-त्तिः) Production of fruit. E. फल fruit, उत् over, पति ruler; or फलाय उत्पत्तिरस्य ।
फलोदय: फलोदय m. (-यः) 	 1. Gain, profit. 	 2. Heaven, paradise. 	 3. Joy, happiness. 4. Consequence, result.  E. फल fruit, gain, &c. उदय rising.
फलोद्देश: फलोद्देश m. (-शः) Regard to results.  E. फल and उद्देश pointing out.
फलोपेत: फलोपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having or yielding fruit, &c.  E. फल and उपेत possessing.
फल्क: फल्क m. (-ल्कः) An expanded or extended body.  E. फल् to separate, Unādi aff. क । “विशोधिताङ्गे च” ।
फल्ग: फल्ग mfn. (-ल्गुः-ल्गुः-ल्गु) 	 1. Pithless, sapless. 	 2. Vain, unprofitable, unmeaning, useless. 	 3. Weak, feeble. 	 f. (-ल्गुः) 	 1. The opposite leaved fig-tree, (F. oppositi-folia, Rox.) 	 2. The name of a river which is said to run underneath Gya. 	 3. Falsehood, false or lying speech. 	 4. A red powder, usually of the root of wild ginger, col-oured with sappan wood, and thrown over one another by the Hindus, at the Holi festival. 	 5. The spring season.  E. फल् to bear fruit, Unādi aff. गुक ।
फल्गुन: फल्गुन m. (-नः) 	 1. A name of ARJUNA. The month Phālguna. 	 f. (-नी) The constellation Phalguni.  E. फल् to bear fruit, Unādi aff. उनन् and गुक् aug.: see फाल्गुन ।
फल्गुनाल: फल्गुनाल m. (-लः) The month Phālguna.  E. फल्गु, and अल equal to, the same.
फल्य: फल्य n. (-ल्यं) A bud, a flower.  E. फल fruit, यत् aff.
फल्लकिन्: फल्लकिन् m. (-की) A fish, caught in ponds, commonly Phalūi, (Mystus kapirat.)
फाट्: फाट् Ind. An interjection of calling.
फाणि: फाणि f. (-णिः) 	 1. Unrefined sugar, molasses. 	 2. Flour or meal mixed with curds.  E. स्फायी to swell, Unādi aff. नि, deriv. irr.
फाणित: फाणित n. (-तं) Raw sugar, the inspissated juice of the sugarcane.  E. फण् to go, causal form, aff. क्त ।
फाण्ट: फाण्ट mfn. (-ण्टः-ण्टा-ण्टं) Readily prepared, made by an extemporaneous easy process, (decoction, &c.) 	 n. (-ण्टं) 	 1. Diluted decoction, decoc-tion, easily prepared. 	 2. The first particles of butter that are produced by churning.  E. फण् to prepare easily, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.
फाल: फाल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Made of cotton, (vesture.) 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. A name of SĪVA. 	 2. A name of BALARĀMA. 	 3. A citron tree. 	 n. (-लं) The share of a plough.  E. फल् to divide, in the causal form. aff. घञ् or फल fruit and अण् aff.
फालकृष्ट: फालकृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Furrowed, ploughed. 	 n. (-ष्टं) A ploughed-field. E. फाल and कृष्ट furrowed.
फाल्गुन: फाल्गुन m. (-नः) 	 1. A name of ARJUNA. 	 2. A sort of tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna.) 	 3. A month, commonly called by the name Phālguna, (February-March.) 	 f. (-नी) 	 1. Day of full moon on the month of Phālguṇa, on which Holi or great vernal festival of the Hindus is celebrated. 	 2. A name common to the eleventh and twelfth lunar asterisms, distinguished by the epithets first and last, or पूर्व्व and उत्तरफाल्गुनीः see पूर्व्वफाल्गुनी &c.
फाल्गुनानुज: फाल्गुनानुज m. (-जः) Spring.  E. फाल्गुन the month, अनु according, ज born.
फाल्गुनिक: फाल्गुनिक m. (-कः) The month Phālguna.  E. फाल्गुनी day of full moon in this month, and ठक् aff.
फि: फि m. (फिः) Anger, passion.  E. फल् to separate, aff. डि ।
फिङ्गक: फिङ्गक m. (-कः) The fork-tailed shrike.  E. फिङ्ग imitative sound, कै to utter, aff. ड ।
फिरङ्ग: फिरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. The country of the Franks. 	 2. A particular disease. It is a word of foreign origin.
फुट: फुट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 	 1. Blown. 	 2. Burst. 	 3. The hood or expanded neck of a snake.  E. स्फुट् to swell, aff. क, deriv. irr.
फु: फु(फू)त् Ind. 	 1. Expression of disregard or contempt, (Phoo, hoot.) 	 2. Imitative sound, implying the bubbling or boiling of water, &c. or of blowing into any liquid.  E. स्फुर् to swell, aff. क्विप्, स rejected, and तुक् added, form irr.
फुत्कर: फुत्कर m. (-रः) Fire.  E. फुत् boiling and कर who makes.
फुत्कार: फुत्कार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Arrogant, contemptuous, disdainful. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. The sound of bubbling or breathing into, (as to cool it.)  E. फुत् expression of contempt, and कार who makes.
फुत्कृत: फुत्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Blown up, (as a bubble.) 	 2. Blown into, cooled by blowing into it.  E. फुत् and कृत made.
फुप्फुस: फुप्फुस m. (-सः) The lungs see पुप्फुस ।
फुल्ल: फुल्ल r. 1st cl. (फुल्लति) To blow or blossom, to bud or flower.
फुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) 	 1. Blown, opened, expanded, (as a flower.) 	 2. Opened, (as the eyes with pleasure, &c.), smiling, gay.  E. फुल्ल् to blow, aff. अच्; also फुल्त ।
फुल्लदामन्: फुल्लदामन् n. (-म) A species of the Atidhriti metre.
फुल्लनयन: फुल्लनयन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Full or large-eyed. 	 2. Smiling, looking hap-py.  E. फुल्ल and नयन the eye; also similar compounds, as फुल्लनेत्र, फुल्लदृष्टि, &c.
फुल्लफाल: फुल्लफाल m. (-लः) Winnowing corn.  E. फुल्ल blown, and फाल for स्फाल् spreading.
फुल्ललोचन: फुल्ललोचन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Full-eyed. 	 2. Looking pleased or happy. 	 n. (-नं) A large full eye. 	 m. (-नः) A species of the antelope.  E. फुल्ल् full, expanded, and लोचन the eye.
फुल्लवत्: फुल्लवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Blossoming, blowing.  E. फुल्ल् to blow, क्तवतु aff.
फुल्लवदन: फुल्लवदन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Looking pleased or happy.  E. फुल्ल् and वदन the face.
फुल्लि: फुल्लि f. (-ल्लिः) Blowing, blossoming.  E. फुल्ल् to blow, aff. इन् ।
फुल्लति: फुल्लति f. (-तिः) Flowering, blossoming.  E. फुल्ल् to blow, क्तिन् aff.
फूत्: फूत् Ind. Imitative sound of bubbling, sobbing, &c.: see फुत्.
फूत्कार: फूत्कार m. (-रः) 	 1. Bubbling. 	 2. Sobbing. 	 3. Blowing or breathing into any liquid.  E. फूत् and कार making.
फूत्कृत: फूत्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Bubbled, bubbling, made to sound so. 	 2. Blown or breathed into, (a liquid.) 	 3. Sounded, as in sobbing. E. फूत्, and कृत made.
फे: फे(ण)न m. (-नः) 	 1. Froth, foam. 	 2. Cuttle-fish-bone, supposed to be the indurated foam of the sea. 	 3. Vapour.  E. स्फायी to swell, नक् Unādi aff., deriv. irr.
फे(ण)नक m. (-कः) Cuttle-fish-bone. 	 f. (-का) 	 1. Rice, ground and boiled with water. 	 2. The soap berry.  E. फेन froth, and कन् aff.
फेनता: फेनता f. (-ता) Frothiness, vapour.  E. तल् added to फेन; also with त्व, फेनत्वं ।
फेनल: फेनल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Frothy, foamy.  E. फेन froth, अलच् poss. aff.; also with इलच् similar aff. फेनिल, and with the usual possessive मतुप्, फेनवत् ।
फेनवत्: फेनवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Frothy, foaming, bubbling.  E. फेन froth and मतुप् aff.
फेनवाहिन्: फेनवाहिन् m. (-ही) The thunderbolt of INDRA.  E. फेन foam, वह् to bear, aff. णिनि; INDRA having used the foam of the sea for his thunder-bolt, to kill the demon VRITRĀSURA.
फेनाग्र: फेनाग्र n. (-ग्रं) A bubble.  E. फेन foam, and अग्र top.
फेनायमान: फेनायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Foaming, frothing.  E. फेन nom. verb to foam, शनच् aff.
फेनाशनि: फेनाशनि m. (-निः) A name of INDRA.  E. फेन foam and अशनि the thund-bolt: see फेनवाहिन् ।
फेनि: फेनि(णि)का f. (-का) 	 1. Froth arising from treacle. 	 2. A kind of sweet-meat called Patty. “खाजा” ।  E. फेन foam, कन् added, fem. form.
फेनिल: फेनिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Frothy, foamy. 	 m. (-लः) The soap plant, (Sapin-dus detergens, Rox.) 	 n. (-लं) 	 1. The fruit of the jujube. 	 2. The fruit of the Vangueria spinosa.  E. फेन froth or foam, इलच् aff.
फेरण्ड: फेरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A jackal.  E. फे imitative sound, रम् to sport, aff. ड ।
फेरव: फेरव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 	 1. Fraudulent, crafty, a rogue or cheat. 	 2. Mali-cious, noxious, injurious. 	 m. (-वः) 	 1. A jackal. 	 2. A demon, a goblin.  E. फे imitative sound, रु to utter, aff. अप् ।
फेरु: फेरु m. (-रुः) A jackal.  E. फे imitative sound, रु to cry, aff. डु ।
फेल: फेल (ऋ) फेऌ r. 1st cl. (फेलति) To go or move.
फेलक: फेलक m. (-कः) Orts, leavings of a meal, or droppings from the mouth. E. फेल् to go, वुन् aff.
फेला: फेला f. (-ला) Orts, leavings.  E. फेल् to go, अच् aff. fem. aff. टाप्; also फेलक and फेलि ।
फेलि: फेलि f. (-लिः or -ली) Orts, leavings.  E. फेल् to go, इन् aff.; ङीप् optionally added; also with टाप् and कन् added, फेलिका f. (-का) ।
